info.name: local-llm API
info.description:
Self-hosted models (Nemotron Parse system deployment plus admin deployments) behind llm-gateway.

Setup:
1. Start the service (`make up` at the repository root, or `docker compose up --build` in services/local-llm) and wait until Readiness returns 200.
2. Set `inferenceApiKey` (LOCAL_LLM_INFERENCE_API_KEY) and `adminApiKey` (LOCAL_LLM_ADMIN_API_KEY).
3. Run the collection in order. Folder 2 deploys Qwen3.5-0.8B (GGUF Q4_K_M) and waits until it is ready; folder 6 removes it.

Errors: `/v1` uses the OpenAI envelope `{"error": {message, type, param, code}}`; `/admin/v1` uses RFC 9457 problem+json with `code` and `requestId`.
Every response carries `X-Request-ID`.

Gateway: every ready deployment registers itself with llm-gateway (`PUT /v1/local-models/{name}`) and sends `api_key` = LOCAL_LLM_INFERENCE_API_KEY, which the gateway stores encrypted to call `/v1` here. Advertised `base_url`: `http://local-llm:8000/v1` on the platform network.

Not triggered here: 503 `at_capacity` + Retry-After when a deployment's queue is full; 504 `inference_timeout`; 502 `inference_failed` (engine crash).

request.description: 200 while the process runs.
200 once the system deployment (Nemotron Parse) is loaded; 503 while starting or shutting down.
CPU cores, RAM, GPUs, memory budgets per device and which engines can use a GPU.
Every deployment with status, device, memory and throughput (tokens/s, pages/min).

item.name: Remove chat deployment left by a previous run

request.description: Makes the run repeatable. 204 if it existed, 404 otherwise.

Resolves the model on Hugging Face, reserves memory (409 if it cannot fit), then downloads and loads in the background. `org/repo:QUANT` selects llama.cpp; `org/repo` with safetensors selects Transformers.

item.name: Wait until chat deployment is ready

request.description: Polls every 5 s (up to 10 minutes) until the deployment is `ready`. Loading downloads weights on first use.

exec: pm.test("Thinking switch detected from the chat template", () => pm.expect(deployment.reasoning_control).to.eql("enable_thinking"));
pm.test("Configured values next to resolved ones", () => { pm.expect(deployment.configured.device).to.eql("auto"); pm.expect(deployment.configured.reasoning_control).to.eql("auto"); });

request.description: Status, device, memory (estimated, reserved, measured) and throughput. `configured` holds exactly what the admin set; the top-level fields are what the service resolved (for example `configured.device: auto` vs `resolved_device: cpu`). `reasoning_control` is what was registered with llm-gateway (`auto` detects Qwen's `enable_thinking` switch).
Settings that do not change the model apply immediately and re-register with the gateway. A new `model_id` or `revision` swaps the model while the old one keeps serving.
Deployments that are ready to serve.

exec: pm.test("Found the title", () => pm.expect(content).to.include("Quarterly Service Report"));

request.description: One page image (data URI) in; Nemotron's raw markup out: `<x_left><y_top>content<x_right><y_bottom><class_NAME>` blocks with normalised boxes. Callers go through llm-gateway with `model: "document_parse"`; post-process with NVIDIA's `postprocess_document`.
Non-streamed completion from the GGUF chat deployment.
Server-Sent Events, `data: [DONE]` at the end; `stream_options.include_usage` adds a usage chunk.

item.name: Chat with an image (Qwen vision projector)

request.description: Images must be base64 data URIs; remote URLs are refused.
Frees memory and marks the deployment unavailable on llm-gateway. Configuration is kept.

item.name: Inference on an unloaded deployment is 503

request.description: The gateway falls back to another model on 503.
Loads again (weights are cached) and re-registers with the gateway when ready.

item.name: Wait until chat deployment (after load) is ready

request.description: Polls every 5 s (up to 10 minutes) until the deployment is `ready`. Loading downloads weights on first use.
Unload and load again; the memory reservation is kept meanwhile.

item.name: Wait until chat deployment (after restart) is ready

request.description: Polls every 5 s (up to 10 minutes) until the deployment is `ready`. Loading downloads weights on first use.
Missing and wrong keys get the same response.

item.name: 401 - admin API with the inference key

request.description: The two keys are separate.
`model` must be a deployment name.
Only data URIs; the service never fetches URLs (no SSRF).

item.name: 422 - Nemotron needs exactly one page image

request.description: Two images in one parse request are refused.

item.name: 422 - Nemotron prompt must be task tokens

request.description: Free text is refused; send task tokens such as `<output_markdown>` or nothing.
Rejected from Content-Length before the body is read.
Names follow the gateway pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{0,127}$`.
The model is resolved before anything is reserved or downloaded.

item.name: 422 - GGUF quantisation not in the repo

request.description: The message lists the quantisations that exist.

item.name: 422 - repository code from an untrusted organisation

request.description: Models that execute their own Python are allowed only from LOCAL_LLM_TRUSTED_CODE_ORGANIZATIONS.
Refused before download, so it can never take down Nemotron Parse.
Names are unique.

item.name: 403 - the system deployment cannot be deleted

request.description: Nemotron Parse can be restarted or upgraded (PATCH), never removed.

item.name: 403 - the system deployment cannot be unloaded

request.description: Unloads, forgets the deployment and marks it unavailable on llm-gateway.
